display.purpose: Page-owning h1. One per page, in the hero. Fraunces at tightened 1.08 leading.

headline.purpose: Section openers that carry the narrative spine of a long page.

title.purpose: Card and tool headings. Steps to weight 600 because small Fraunces needs it.

body.purpose: All prose, set in Soft Ink rather than full Ink. Inter.

label.purpose: KPI labels and preview captions. Uppercase, wide-tracked, Soft Ink or darker.

eyebrow.purpose: Section kickers in Leaf Green, prefixed by a 24px leaf-green rule.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default for cards and light buttons. Separates without lifting.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards and light buttons; resting state for genuinely floating panels.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Modals, drawers, and the chat widget. Reserved — this tier is what makes an overlay read as an overlay.

shadows.name: brand-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest. A green-tinted shadow, never neutral.

shadows.name: brand-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover, paired with a -2px lift.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Form control focus. Replaces the removed native outline — never omit both.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for the whole system. Fast out, long settle.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for surfaces, backgrounds, and shadows.

motion.name: dur-control
motion.purpose: Faster duration for controls and icon nudges, where 0.5s feels sluggish.

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: Chip hover and other small lifts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global override under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. All animation and transition durations collapse; smooth scrolling is disabled.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brand action. Fully-round pill in Leaf Green carrying its own green-tinted glow; lifts and deepens on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Explore your land <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; background: var(--brand, #2f6b3a); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(47,107,58,.28); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-deep, #1f4d28); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(47,107,58,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(47,107,58,.28), 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,107,58,.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. Hairline-bordered pill that inverts fully to Soil Ink on hover rather than merely tinting.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); border: 1.5px solid rgba(29,26,21,.14); transition: background .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); background: var(--ink, #1d1a15); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,107,58,.25); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: The bento card. 22px radius on Surface White with a hairline border and a 3px accent bar that scales in from the left on hover.
components.html:
Market

Know when to sell

Six-month price forecasts and a best-time-to-sell advisor built on real mandi history.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid rgba(29,26,21,.06); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29,26,21,.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(29,26,21,.04); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--accent, #c88a3a); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); z-index: 2; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(29,26,21,.08), 0 12px 30px rgba(29,26,21,.06); } .ds-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-card__eyebrow { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent, #c88a3a); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'Fraunces', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card__body { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); margin: 0; }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: Signature component. The dashboard readout — Soft Paper tile with an uppercase label over a large value; semantic variants re-tint the whole tile.
components.html:
Net profit
₹1.24 L
ROI 62% · 3 acres
components.css: .ds-kpi { padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg-soft, #f4ede0); overflow: hidden; min-width: 0; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-kpi:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29,26,21,.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(29,26,21,.04); } .ds-kpi__lbl { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); } .ds-kpi__val { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); margin-top: 6px; } .ds-kpi__sub { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); margin-top: 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-kpi--good { background: var(--brand-soft, #e8f3ea); } .ds-kpi--good .ds-kpi__val { color: var(--brand-deep, #1f4d28); } .ds-kpi--warn { background: var(--accent-soft, #f7ecd7); } .ds-kpi--warn .ds-kpi__val { color: var(--clay, #a5562a); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Form control that fills on focus — Paper at rest, white when focused, with a green border and 3px glow replacing the native outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field__lbl { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(29,26,21,.1); background: var(--bg, #faf6ef); font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); transition: border-color .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--brand, #2f6b3a); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,107,58,.15); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Metadata and filter pill in Soft Paper. Lifts 1px into the resting shadow on hover. Not a button — actions use pill buttons.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-soft, #f4ede0); border: 1px solid rgba(29,26,21,.06); font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); white-space: nowrap; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29,26,21,.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(29,26,21,.04); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; transition: background .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-nav--scrolled { background: rgba(250,246,239,.85); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(29,26,21,.06); } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: 'Fraunces', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 24px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav__links a { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4339); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: var(--ink, #1d1a15); } .ds-nav__links a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,107,58,.25); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
A working notebook kept at the edge of a field — warm paper, a serif hand for the things that matter, and margins filled with numbers earned rather than assumed. The palette is taken from the subject itself: leaf, wheat, soil, monsoon. Nothing here is borrowed from the sterile blue-and-grey vocabulary of B2B SaaS, and that departure is deliberate.

The register is warm but confident and alive. The grounded palette and paper background do the reassuring; motion, scale, and a disciplined accent do the rest. Surfaces respond when touched — cards lift, buttons rise two pixels, arrows slide forward — so the product reads as something modern and responsive rather than a form that happens to be beige. A farmer making a season-defining decision should feel steadied, not hurried; the interface earns trust by being legible and specific, never by shouting.

The system serves two very different sessions on the same tokens: a farmer's short, high-stakes visit and an advisor's long comparative one. The resolution is that warmth lives in the shell — paper, radii, serif headings — while the interior stays exact. Numbers are tabular, labels are uppercase and small, and colour carries meaning rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#faf6ef), never pure white as the page
Fraunces serif for headings, Inter for everything operational
Fully-round pill buttons and generous 22px card radii
Depth from tonal layering and hairline borders first, shadow as a response to state
A four-colour agricultural accent set, one accent per context
Contrast reasoning documented inline in the stylesheet, not improvised

rules.name: The Legibility Over Palette Rule
rules.body: When an accent cannot carry text at the required contrast, the text goes high-contrast and the accent moves to a dot, bar, or border instead. The stylesheet already enforces this in two places and says so in comments: --ink-faint is rejected for small supporting text because it only reaches 3.5:1 on paper, and diagnosis confidence numbers stay --ink because Monsoon Blue on paper is 2.4:1. Colour signals category; it does not get to cost legibility.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: --bg is the page and --surface is what sits on it. A full-bleed white background is a bug, not a style choice — it collapses the tonal stack that this system uses instead of heavy shadows.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Context Rule
rules.body: A card, tile, or section commits to a single accent from the four (leaf / wheat / clay / monsoon) and expresses it through the --f-accent / --f-soft pair. Mixing two accents inside one component reads as decoration and drops the semantic link between colour and meaning.

rules.name: The Serif Stops at the Data Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for headings and hero statements only. Every number, form control, label, table cell, and chip is Inter. A serif quintal figure is a category error — the serif is the voice, not the instrument.

rules.name: The Tightened Display Rule
rules.body: All Fraunces headings run at 1.08 line-height with -0.02em tracking. Large serif set at default spacing drifts apart and loses the printed quality the North Star depends on.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest sits at Resting or flat. Raised and Lifted are responses — to hover, to focus, to genuinely floating above the page. A component that ships at Lifted while idle has taken the modal tier for itself.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is rgba(29, 26, 21, …) — the ink colour, not black. A neutral grey-black shadow on this paper reads cold immediately and breaks the ground.

rules.name: The Pill and the Panel Rule
rules.body: Anything you press is a pill. Anything that holds content is a panel at 14–22px. A square-cornered button or a pill-shaped content card both break the system's most legible convention.

rules.name: The Fill-On-Focus Rule
rules.body: An input at rest is Paper; a focused input is white. The field lifts out of the page as you enter it, which is the same earned-elevation logic applied to form controls.

dos: Do build on the Paper ground (#faf6ef) and treat white as a raised surface.
Do set every heading in Fraunces at 1.08 line-height with -0.02em tracking, and everything operational in Inter.
Do make buttons fully round (999px) and content containers 14–22px.
Do give each card or tile exactly one accent via --f-accent / --f-soft.
Do tint shadows with the ink colour rgba(29,26,21, …), and tint the primary button's glow green.
Do replace any removed outline with the 3px rgba(47,107,58,.15) focus ring.
Do use --ink-soft for small supporting text; --ink-faint is for large or decorative text only.
Do update toolbar.js's dark block whenever you add a component with a hardcoded light surface.
Do route new motion through --ease (cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)) and --dur (.5s).
donts: Don't set small text in Monsoon Blue or --ink-faint on paper — 2.4:1 and 3.5:1 respectively. Move the colour to a dot, bar, or border and keep the text high-contrast.
Don't use pure #000 for text or #fff for the page background.
Don't ship a component at the Lifted shadow tier while idle; that tier belongs to overlays.
Don't set numbers, labels, form controls, or table cells in Fraunces.
Don't mix two accents inside a single card or tile.
Don't use neutral grey-black shadows — they read cold against the warm ground immediately.
Don't introduce a new breakpoint when 860px or 640px will do.
Don't re-enable animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't reach for the sterile blue/grey SaaS palette; the agricultural accent set is the identity.
